markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Normal (92%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set [F1], unanimous model/neighbor agreement, and unflagged tier-1 surgical frozen-section status support routine review.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Normal 92%, InSitu 6%, Benign 2%, Invasive 0% (ECE 5%, n=132) | Strong Normal call; 0% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | {Normal} at α=10% (90% dataset coverage, n=132) | Single class at 90% dataset guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliability, 88% OOD percentile, 12/12 regions kept [F6] (AUROC 70%) | Unflagged quality; moderately high OOD |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | true (same top class) | Independent foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Normal (90%–92% similarity) [F5]; contrast InSitu BACH_0117 (86%) | Unanimous Normal neighbor match |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 3, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Unreliable score (-0.825, value 1.25) [F2]; failed AI spot check (0/20) · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 3, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score (-0.458, value 1.22) opposing invasion [F3] (20/20 spot check) · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 0, 1, 5) · ↓ invasive · Text-only score (-0.415, value 1.38), caption-inconsistent [F4] (18/20 spot check) · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Positive score (+0.26, value 0.85) despite 0.0 tile risk (19/20 spot check) · Validated
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 1) · context · Descriptive score (-0.242, value 0.83) with borderline AI spot check (8/20) · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions beats random deletion (+0.0114, 95% CI +0.0021 to +0.0197, n=132).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (diff +0.0008, 95% CI -0.0088 to +0.0064); top driver normal_lobules (-0.825) is unreliable (0/20 spot check).

## Could be wrong if
- Focal DCIS mimics Normal tissue (6% InSitu probability; 86% similarity to InSitu case BACH_0117 differing in pleomorphism and tubules).
- Near-threshold margin segments (inferior 100%, lateral 99%, superior 96% vs 0.9998 cutoff) represent involvement despite clear call [F7].

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 3, 6, 10**: Highest classifier risk tiles (0.001–0.013) and peak duct-confined score in region 6 (0.89).
2. **Regions 3, 10, 11**: Unreliable normal_lobules score, region 11 invasion signal (1.27), and near-threshold inferior/lateral/superior margins.
3. **Regions 0, 1, 5**: Verify benign tubules and nuclear uniformity against InSitu contrast case BACH_0117 and region 1 TILs.
